sn1.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme ||
sn1.11:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || ||
sn1.11:2.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave aññatarā Tāvatiṃsa-kāyikā devatā Nandanavane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcakāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.11:4.1: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave aññatarā devatā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi || ||
sn1.11:5.6: tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho ti || || Ekam antaṃ
